keywords: Writs of Certiorari and Mandamus – Excise duty concession – Rectified spirits used in manufacture of air freshener and detergent – Exporter claiming treatment as exporter of liquor – Excise Notification Nos. 878 and 937 – Definition of liquor – Rectified spirit as ingredient distinguished from final product – Ministerial and Excise Commissioner discretion – Wednesbury unreasonableness – Legitimate expectation – Representation by Deputy Secretary to Treasury – Representation outside statutory authority – Ultra vires representation cannot create legitimate expectation – No locus to challenge notifications on asserted basis – Application dismissed without costs.
